transcript: I'm just sitting here watching The Eras Tour and realizing that like, we're gonna get a whole new set of speeches she's not gonna do these same speeches. We're gonna get all new speeches from Taylor. We're gonna get an all new professional recording of The Eras Tour with The Tortured Poets Department set. And I just got full body chills. I'm like, not ready. I'm so ready, but I'm also not ready. And I'm just so excited to relive it all again 'cause I miss it everyday I miss the Eras Tour everyday. And we're just gonna get all her cute little speeches and performances. And what do we think the surprise songs are gonna be? What ones do you think they're gonna include? Oh, I'm so excited! OHHH I'm so excited! Look at her! That's our girl!
